authorized_scope: All 97 recon findings; user authorized autonomous implementation on 2026-10-02 America/Lima. Merge/deploy remain separate.

findings.title: Chat events are broadcast across organizations when the payload has no top-level agent id
acceptance: Connect org A and org B, emit delta/final/error/injected chat for A, assert B receives zero frames and A receives exactly one.
Connect two users in one org with disjoint assigned agents and assert only the assigned recipient sees the session event.
Assert an audience-required event with no resolvable owner is refused and logged without message content.

findings.title: Session and chat methods bypass assigned-agent authorization when the selector is sessionKey
acceptance: Assigned user A cannot history/send/abort/patch/delete a session owned by agent B.
sessions.list, preview, and usage return only authorized resources.
Admin behavior and legacy single-tenant token behavior remain explicitly covered.

tests.scope: Hub issuer signed claims, jti uniqueness, actualSQL cross-org agent exclusion

tests: Hub dependency: 31 tests across actual PostgreSQL authority, signed JWT issuance/verification, installed SvelteKit text-ID routing, exact identity bypass and Sentry forwarded-credential scrubbing passed. evidence/hub-authority-tests.log; independent review pending.

findings.title: Any authenticated write-scoped user can join and mutate any guessed workshop room
acceptance: Org B cannot join, sync, claim authority, or submit a binary update to org A's save id.
A binary frame whose room id differs from the authorized membership is discarded and audited.
Legacy rooms are migrated or denied according to an explicit policy.
tests: Hub dependency: 31 tests across actual PostgreSQL authority, signed JWT issuance/verification, installed SvelteKit text-ID routing, exact identity bypass and Sentry forwarded-credential scrubbing passed. evidence/hub-authority-tests.log; independent review pending.

findings.title: Normal users can enumerate and invoke globally registered nodes and browser relays
acceptance: Org B cannot list, describe, invoke, or browser-proxy through org A's node.
Org administrators can access only their org; platform admins retain explicit global behavior.
Unowned legacy nodes fail closed until claimed/migrated.

findings.title: Events, raw logs, and usage endpoints expose gateway-global operational data to normal users
acceptance: User/org-admin requests never return another org's events, usage, or logs.
Queries without an owner predicate fail closed for tenant identities.
Admin access is explicit and sensitive fields are redaction-tested.

findings.title: JWT revocation neither disconnects active sockets nor survives gateway restart
acceptance: Revoking jti closes an active socket and blocks subsequent frames.
Restart the revocation store and assert the token remains rejected until expiry.
A different jti for the same user remains usable unless user-wide revocation is requested.

tests.scope: Hub issuer signed claims, jti uniqueness, actualSQL cross-org agent exclusion

tests: Hub dependency: 31 tests across actual PostgreSQL authority, signed JWT issuance/verification, installed SvelteKit text-ID routing, exact identity bypass and Sentry forwarded-credential scrubbing passed. evidence/hub-authority-tests.log; independent review pending.

findings.title: Concurrent connect frames can authenticate one socket twice and leave a ghost client entry
acceptance: Pause first-token verification, send a second connect, then resolve both; exactly one client is registered.
Close the socket and assert the client set and per-user connection count are empty.
Repeat with different org/scopes and assert the second identity is never observable.

findings.title: bestEffort delivery without an onError callback acknowledges and deletes partially failed queue entries
acceptance: bestEffort true plus no onError plus one rejected payload must call failDelivery and never ackDelivery.
Mixed success/failure returns an explicit partial result.
Restart sentinel and node receipt callers surface the failure without duplicating successful payloads.

findings.title: A single cleanup error or hung channel stop aborts the remaining gateway shutdown sequence
acceptance: Inject a throw/hang into each early cleanup and assert every later finalizer runs once.
Call close twice and assert idempotent completion.
Assert shutdown meets a fixed deadline while reporting timed-out components.

findings.title: Gateway startup creates background resources that are not reliably owned or stopped
acceptance: Close while event init is paused, then resolve init; no timer/store remains.
Start/close repeatedly under fake timers and assert zero scheduled handles.
Spy every returned shutdown handle and workshop DB close; each runs once.

findings.title: Cron timeout and service stop mark work finished without cancelling the underlying agent run
acceptance: A timed-out deferred run observes abort and cannot deliver after the scheduler records timeout.
A replacement/manual run cannot overlap the same generation unless policy explicitly permits it.
stop aborts and awaits active jobs, including a tool call blocked on I/O.

findings.title: Brain-vector leases are not fenced and external effects have no durable receipt boundary
acceptance: Worker A lease expires, worker B reclaims, then A ACK/retry/dead-letter all return false and cannot mutate B's claim.
Qdrant succeeds and ACK fails; retry uses a durable receipt and does not recompute paid embedding.
Abort during provider/Qdrant work reaches a stable uncertain state before close.
Migration with unexpected catalog/version refuses before irreversible execution when feasible.

findings.title: Workshop binary sync bypasses the gateway's slow-consumer and bounded-work controls
acceptance: Oversized/rate-exceeded updates are rejected before Yjs apply.
A client above bufferedAmount threshold is disconnected and no further sends occur.
Document/room quotas hold under repeated updates and empty-room churn.

findings.title: Bulk tag writes treat every HTTP response as success
findings.acceptance: Inject a 503 for /api/tags/bulk and one failed CRM fan-out response; assert error/partial feedback, no success toast, and failed staged intent remains.

findings.title: Selections survive data/query replacement and can act on hidden record IDs
findings.acceptance: Select A, replace data/query with B, then invoke each bulk action; assert A is cleared or explicitly disclosed and never silently submitted.

findings.title: Compound entity-plus-tag saves report success after the tag write fails
findings.acceptance: Force the second write to 503 after a successful primary write; assert committed-partial feedback, preserved tag draft, and retry only the tag write.

findings.title: Add gateway is an unchecked dual write that can show success with half the gateway missing
findings.acceptance: Make the second endpoint fail and assert no generic success, no draft erasure, and an idempotent repair path that does not duplicate /api/servers.

findings.title: Voided tickets render as green Submitted because the client checks the wrong status literal
findings.acceptance: Render the detail with status 'void'; assert Voided/error, and add a compile-time shared status exhaustiveness test.

findings.title: Calendar loads in the organization timezone but lays out and writes in the browser timezone
findings.acceptance: Run with browser TZ UTC and org TZ America/Lima, including a near-midnight booking and a 09:00 drag/drop round trip; assert display, cache key, request instant, and now line are org-zoned.

findings.title: A drag can partially commit custom lane, group members, and time/resource as independent writes
findings.acceptance: Fail one member custom save and separately fail the move after custom success; assert no silent split-brain and an explicit retry/rollback state.

findings.title: In-flight week responses can overwrite post-mutation data or resurrect evicted weeks
findings.acceptance: Use deferred promises: start old fetch, mutate/refetch, resolve old last; assert only new generation appears. Repeat with eviction and assert old response is discarded.

findings.title: A failed visible week is rendered as a genuinely empty schedule until another scroll settles
findings.acceptance: Fail the visible week and do not emit another range settle; assert it is labeled unavailable with Retry, then succeeds from that control.

findings.title: Board reclassification is pointer-drag-only
findings.acceptance: Keyboard-focus a card, choose Move to and a target column, assert one write, updated column, announcement, and focus retention.

findings.title: Older reliability responses can overwrite newer range/filter/host selections
findings.acceptance: Resolve request B before request A for every aggregate; assert B remains, A is ignored, and loading stays true until B completes.

findings.title: Nested delete buttons bubble Enter into card navigation; Flow and Workshop also mishandle Space
findings.acceptance: For every card grid, keyboard-activate delete and assert only delete/confirmation runs; activate the card itself and assert only navigation runs.

findings.title: Hand-rolled overlays bypass the shared dialog contract; HostsOverlay even swallows Escape from its content
findings.acceptance: Assert :modal/inert background, trapped Tab/Shift+Tab, Escape from an inner input, outside dismissal policy, scroll lock, and trigger focus restoration.

findings.title: Anonymous callers can trigger global marketplace synchronization
findings.acceptance: Assert anonymous=401, ordinary member=403, authorized sync=200, and two concurrent authorized calls execute one provider fetch/update.

findings.title: Capability enforcement does not cover several privileged platform mutations
findings.acceptance: Inventory every mutating +server.ts at test time; fail if no explicit public/authenticated/capability policy. Exercise a restricted member against each listed domain and expect 403 without writes.

findings.title: The automatic backup and chat/unified-event retention scheduler has no production entrypoint
findings.acceptance: Use a fake clock and disposable database to prove the deployed entrypoint claims once, creates the due backup, performs due retention, records success/failure, and does not double-run across two workers.

findings.title: Stored-value balances add nominal amounts across currencies
findings.acceptance: Create mixed-currency entries and assert per-currency balances and rejection/explicit conversion of a mismatched redemption; run the preserved fixture recipe in hs-numeric-repro.README.md.

findings.title: Manual credit adjustments have no idempotency key
findings.acceptance: Drop the first HTTP response after commit, retry the same key, and assert one ledger row and the identical response; changing payload under the key must conflict.

findings.title: Ticket submission has no idempotency key
findings.acceptance: Force a post-commit transport failure and retry the same key; assert one ticket, one payment set, one credit effect, one stock source, and stable response.

findings.title: Any payment method whose identifier is credit debits stored value
findings.acceptance: Configure a non-stored-value method with the display label Credit and prove it does not debit; configure the semantic stored-value method and prove it does, including migration compatibility.

findings.title: Settled plans and concurrent final installments can be overpaid
findings.acceptance: Use two database connections to race final installments and assert at most one full remaining payment; assert a settled plan rejects further payment unless an explicit overpayment/refund workflow is chosen. Rewrite the current negative-remaining assertion.

findings.title: Concurrent first movements into an absent bin can lose on-hand quantity
findings.acceptance: With two real PostgreSQL connections and no initial bin row, commit simultaneous receipts and assert one bin equals the sum and its ledger reconstruction; also cover first issue/negative-stock policy.

findings.title: Stock source deduplication is check-then-insert without a database unique key
findings.acceptance: Race two real connections for one source and assert one document/effect; retry after a lost response and assert the same identifier/result.

findings.title: Booking conflict checks do not serialize overlapping inserts
findings.acceptance: Race two connections at a barrier with overlapping times and distinct UIDs; exactly one must commit for capacity one, while adjacent/nonblocking-status cases remain valid.

findings.title: Committed bookings and tickets can permanently miss their stock effects
findings.acceptance: Kill the process at every boundary after commit; restart the worker and prove eventual exactly-once stock effect, visible pending/failed state, and safe duplicate delivery.

findings.title: Assistant reschedule is non-atomic and drops package/payment-plan funding
findings.acceptance: Inject failure after replacement insertion and assert no replacement commits; use a missing old ID and expect 404; reschedule funded bookings and assert exactly one active booking with conserved funding/session count.

findings.title: Finance and CRM rankings aggregate mixed currencies as raw nominal values
findings.acceptance: Seed equivalent and deliberately different PEN/USD invoices with fixed booked rates; assert canonical totals, tax/COGS basis, stable historical reruns, and original-currency drilldown.

findings.title: Scheduling booking reads bypass scheduling:view
findings.acceptance: Enumerate every scheduling GET handler and fail when it lacks an explicit public or view policy; test a no-view member gets 403 from list/detail/calendar while public slug reads still work.

findings.title: Voiding a package sale races a concurrent session redemption
findings.acceptance: Use two PostgreSQL connections and barriers to race void versus redemption. Exactly one valid outcome may commit: void with no live redemption, or redemption with void rejected; never a live redemption on a cancelled grant.

findings.title: Nine Svelte reactive tests pass without executing their $effect.root callbacks
findings.acceptance: The harness canary must prove callback execution. A mutation inside each callback (for example changing the expected initial loading value) must make the suite red. Keep the three pure createConnectedFetch and direct keyed-debouncer cases separate.

tests.scope: 18 mounted owner cases included in128test combined run

reviews.scope: All assertions outside lifecycle callback; owner canaries execute; no production transform change; server/finance suites remain passing.

findings.title: The workforce proxy integration test exercises a copied verifier that has drifted from the runtime middleware
findings.acceptance: Run the same missing-header, malformed token, non-UUID company, UUID match/mismatch, roleKeys, and existing actor vectors against the actual exported middleware. A runtime middleware mutation must fail the Hub compatibility lane without editing a copied fixture.

findings.title: Hub CI always skips the native editor, paste, and sanitizer security qualification
findings.acceptance: The dedicated job must fail when the browser marker/session is absent and must report five tests passed with zero pending. A forced sanitizer or editor mutation must make the job red.

findings.title: Node invocation has no pending-request cap, timeout clamp, or socket backpressure check
acceptance: N+1 invoke is rejected at the configured cap without allocating a timer.
Timeout values outside bounds are normalized/refused.
Slow/closed node sockets fail fast and release pending state.

findings.title: The write-ahead delivery queue provides at-least-once replay but lacks per-payload checkpoints/idempotency
acceptance: Crash after payload 1 acceptance; recovery sends only unfinished payloads.
Partial failure checkpoints successes and retries only failures.
Queue-write failure is observable to durability-required callers.

findings.title: Memory ingest/delete treats every HTTP response as success and has no bounded retry/drain
acceptance: 401/429/500 and timeout produce a visible failure/retry state.
Delete survives restart and is idempotent.
Shutdown persists or drains admitted memory operations within a deadline.

findings.title: Global five-second event sampling drops unrelated tenants' message/tool records before storage
acceptance: Same event from two orgs/agents is stored twice.
Sampling, if retained, exposes an exact dropped count and never changes durable totals.
High-volume load keeps storage/broadcast within defined budgets.

findings.title: The nightly wrapper reports success after dispatch and does not reflect the child DEV CI conclusion
acceptance: Workflow fixture/shell test proves a failing child makes the wrapper fail.
Wrapper validates exact branch/SHA and exposes child URL/conclusion.
No child found within deadline is a failure, not success.

findings.title: Required CI runs unit-style shards while tracked e2e/live suites remain outside every workflow
acceptance: CI configuration test asserts required workflows invoke the deterministic e2e project.
The cross-org broadcaster/session/workshop cases run through real WebSockets.
Fault-injected shutdown and delivery recovery run in a process-level harness.

findings.title: The durable shells receiver is present, but the sender and lifecycle endpoints remain incomplete
acceptance: Power loss after terminal emission resumes commit without duplicate terminal effects.
Bridge disconnect reconciles online state after the defined grace period.
Wake/backup paths enforce org ownership and rollback each failed stage.
Capability negotiation never advertises end-to-end durability before both sides are ready.

findings.title: Event-kind create, rename, recolor, default, and delete ignore rejected responses
findings.acceptance: Return 403 and 500 for each verb; assert draft/value is retained and no success-state invalidation masks the error.

findings.title: Pulse proposal editing closes and discards the draft on any HTTP failure
findings.acceptance: Inject 409/500 and assert editor remains open with unchanged draft and one request; success alone closes it.

findings.title: Date-only quick ranges mix local calendar arithmetic with UTC serialization
findings.acceptance: Set TZ=America/Lima at 2026-10-03T01:30Z and TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati at local 00:30; assert local-day endpoints for every date-only preset.

findings.title: Quick-range 'now' freezes at component mount
findings.acceptance: Mount under fake time, advance hours/across midnight without changing props, click 1h and 1d, and assert bounds use the advanced clock.

findings.title: Built-in status, kind, service, and tag lanes look draggable but cannot reclassify
findings.acceptance: Exercise every built-in axis; assert a supported write changes the value or an unsupported lane rejects the drag before a misleading ghost.

findings.title: Calendar↔Table/Board switching destroys runway and fan interaction state
findings.acceptance: Settle a distant date and fan state, switch views twice, assert same focused date/scroll anchor and documented fan behavior.

findings.title: Multi-tag bookings are filed under only the first server-ordered tag
findings.acceptance: Load two-tag bookings in both server orders; assert stable declared-primary behavior or presence in both lanes without duplicate writes.

findings.title: Loading a new week can add lanes and re-divide every visible day
findings.acceptance: Load week B with a new facet after week A is visible; assert existing lane order/width stays stable.

findings.title: Custom booking fields appear in calendar Table/Board but disappear from Bookings and the detail drawer
findings.acceptance: Seed a custom value and assert identical visible/read-only/editable representation across Table, Board, BookingsView, and drawer for allowed/restricted personas.

findings.title: Month view drops ticket split, drag/resize, external drop, hover detail, and grouped-visit fan behavior
findings.acceptance: For invoiced, grouped, and pending-ticket fixtures, assert month either exposes the supported signal/action or a discoverable transition to the full interaction view.

findings.title: Bookings outside configured hours can render under the sticky header or beyond the track
findings.acceptance: Render before-hours and after-hours bookings; assert visible continuation affordance, bounded hitboxes, and unclipped drag/create overlays.

findings.title: Reliability mount can issue duplicate full data batches
findings.acceptance: Instrument loader counts on mount and stored-default application; assert one request per endpoint per effective key.

findings.title: Several role=button controls omit required Space behavior or all keyboard behavior
findings.acceptance: Tab to each control and assert Enter and Space match click exactly once with visible focus.

findings.title: Date-range configuration menu lacks composite keyboard focus and coarse-pointer target sizing
findings.acceptance: Open by Enter and context menu, navigate with arrows/Home/End, toggle/default, Escape/Tab with focus return; measure every visible target under coarse pointer.

findings.title: Core interactive systems remain multi-thousand-line change hotspots
findings.acceptance: Before extraction, add contract tests at each seam (selection/query replacement, partial bulk outcomes, zoned drag, request generations, event routing); require parity snapshots/call traces after each move.

findings.title: Client interaction E2E coverage is outside the default CI gate and many specs can skip entirely
findings.acceptance: CI meta-test asserts required critical spec IDs executed with passed/failed status (never skipped), and intentionally failing a 503/focus/timezone contract fails the job.

findings.title: Removed memberships can remain authorized in the identity cache for up to 60 seconds
findings.acceptance: Warm the cache, remove/downgrade membership, then make the next sensitive request through the same and a second app instance; both must reject immediately.

findings.title: A stale meta-sync job can be reclaimed repeatedly by concurrent workers
findings.acceptance: With two database connections and a stale job, assert exactly one claimant for a generation; expire/steal it, then prove the old owner can no longer update progress or completion.

findings.title: Finance cache keys ignore whether stock accounting is enabled
findings.acceptance: Seed nonzero COGS, cache summary/series, toggle stock off and on, and assert the next read immediately follows the new state in both directions.

reviews.scope: Contact-detail void aggregate added after review; failing SQLfixture verified then corrected. Source review included ranking/funnel/chart consumers.

findings.title: Five SQL-critical test files are excluded from ordinary tests and absent from explicit CI lanes
findings.acceptance: Add a meta-test that enumerates excluded files and diffs them against every CI contract. It must currently identify exactly the five uncovered files and fail when any unassigned file appears.

findings.title: Stored payment-plan status drifts from ticket-derived reality
findings.acceptance: Inject failure after ticket commit and then void a settling ticket; in both cases assert the plan's authoritative status and remaining amount match its valid allocations.

findings.title: Package sessions are consumed before the sale or booking is committed
findings.acceptance: Redeem/select then abandon and prove the grant returns to available state; submit successfully and prove exactly one final consumption; race two claims for the last session.

findings.title: Series cancellation commits each occurrence independently
findings.acceptance: Inject failure on the third occurrence and assert either all roll back or the response/job records exactly which occurrences committed and a retry completes only the remainder.

findings.title: Concurrent bookings for a new person can create an orphan duplicate contact
findings.acceptance: Race two requests with the same identity and assert one canonical contact, one identity, and both bookings linked to it; include case/country-code normalization.

findings.title: Negative profit and margin are clamped to zero
findings.acceptance: Run the preserved fixture and assert -40 profit and -0.8 margin; add zero/negative-revenue policies and reconciliation to statement lines.

reviews.scope: Contact-detail void aggregate added after review; failing SQLfixture verified then corrected. Source review included ranking/funnel/chart consumers.

findings.title: Void-rate and rankings use inconsistent invoice populations
findings.acceptance: Rewrite the current assertion to 2/3 for the selected denominator and add void-only customer/product cases across summary, series, and CRM ranking.

reviews.scope: Contact-detail void aggregate added after review; failing SQLfixture verified then corrected. Source review included ranking/funnel/chart consumers.

findings.title: Binary floating-point rounding produces 1.00 for 1.005
findings.acceptance: Approve a rounding table first; then property-test exact decimal inputs including ±1.005, large values, allocations, and currencies with 0/2/3 minor units. Keep the fixture expectation aligned with the chosen policy.

findings.title: The supposedly append-only POS credit ledger grants UPDATE and DELETE
findings.acceptance: As authenticated/app role, assert INSERT succeeds for the tenant while UPDATE/DELETE fail; assert a compensating entry changes derived balance and preserves history.

findings.title: Server telemetry delivery is not tied to request lifetime
findings.acceptance: Disposable delayed-ingest fixture: request completes, lifecycle closes, exactly accepted events are delivered or explicit drop counts rise; burst test bounds concurrent flushes.

findings.title: Source-map and live alert qualification remains incomplete
findings.acceptance: Require release SHA -> map artifact -> symbolicated exception -> alert receipt; measure endpoint error/latency and mutation-refresh failure rates with explicit cohorts.

findings.title: The workforce dashboard E2E passes when the company switcher behavior in its title is absent
findings.acceptance: Hide the switcher, return zero workspaces, or provide one company in the integration fixture and assert that the company-switch test fails with a prerequisite diagnostic.

findings.title: The tag-cell E2E can pass without selecting a tag or rendering the chip behavior named by the test
findings.acceptance: An empty picker response and a suppressed post-selection chip must each fail the test.

findings.title: The POS category filter E2E accepts a no-op filter despite a multi-category seed
findings.acceptance: Replace the filter application with a no-op and require the E2E test to fail.

findings.title: Seeded E2E suites turn missing deterministic contract fixtures into runtime skips after the page loads
findings.acceptance: Remove or hide QA-LOW, seeded entries, or QA Priority from the application response; the affected test must fail rather than become pending.

findings.title: PostgreSQL result contracts accept wholesale assertion deletion as long as one passing test remains per file
findings.acceptance: Reject a synthetic report containing one passing assertion per admitted file and reject a report with a missing or renamed expected assertion. Accept additions through an explicit manifest update.

findings.title: Opening bulk tags expands the mobile document beyond the viewport
findings.acceptance: Open and close the bulk tag popover at 390 and 320 px, after rotation, and while horizontally scrolling the table. Assert document scrollWidth equals clientWidth, the panel remains reachable, and keyboard focus/Escape restore correctly. Repeat on a physical touch browser before release.

findings.title: Current planning state still lists attachment defects fixed on master
findings.acceptance: A reconciliation fixture must distinguish fixed source, merged, deployed and runtime-qualified; stale resolved items must not reopen automatically.

tests.command: Attachment PR272/274 git ancestry + meta instruction/index checks

findings.title: Contributor guidance contradicts the canonical branch and database/auth model
findings.acceptance: Run instruction parity/repo-policy checks and a clean-clone onboarding smoke; validate documentation paths against current tree.

findings.title: The meta backlog contains 367 open monitor alerts and repeated reconcile execution failures
findings.acceptance: Run an isolated runner preflight and one controlled reconcile fixture; verify exec succeeds, source identity is recorded, and failure recurrence routes to one incident. No production runner change was made in this audit.

findings.title: Category is offered for color but cannot be selected as a subcolumn
findings.acceptance: Select category, assert named lanes and correct placement including an unclassified category.

findings.title: Truncated calendar lane headers rely on native title text
findings.acceptance: At narrow/coarse-pointer widths, focus/tap a truncated header and assert the full accessible label is available without hover.

findings.title: Page commits during finance sync are invisible until the whole job completes
findings.acceptance: Cache a summary, commit one page, force the deadline branch, and assert the next summary either includes that page or intentionally remains on an explicitly versioned previous snapshot.

findings.title: Equal grant allocation drops the rounding residual
findings.acceptance: Property-test many positive/negative totals and counts: every allocation has currency precision and the exact minor-unit sum equals the source total; update the 100/3 expectation to include the residual.

findings.title: Due schedules are not required to reconcile to plan principal
findings.acceptance: Test under-sum, over-sum, zero/negative rows, residual cents, and schedule exhaustion; assert the selected policy in API errors and collection views.

findings.title: Stock valuation persists unquantized binary-float artifacts
findings.acceptance: Property-test conservation across post/cancel and rebuild, exact ledger-to-bin reconciliation, deterministic results across orderings allowed by policy, and bounded scale for fractional UOM cases.
